$comment: Visit Moganshan news source registry. Consumed by editorial/scripts/sweep.mjs and validated by editorial/scripts/news-lib.mjs (validateRegistry). Tiers per editorial/sources/source-tiers.md. articlePattern is a JS regex matched against absolute hrefs found on the listing pages; it is deliberately URL shaped rather than DOM selector shaped because the URL patterns were verified and the DOM was not. Listing level `filter` controls title matching: none keeps everything, core requires a keywords.core match, all allows core, villages or topics. keywords.excludeNoise is always removed. renderedClientSide and manualOnly listings are skipped by the crawler and listed in the manual check section of the triage file. isSearch means the listing URL is itself a keyword query, so no title filter is applied.

sources.cadence: 4 to 6 tourism items per week, daily in news channels
sources.publishes: County tourism, events, tea season, races, openings, local policy
sources.authority: Reliable for what is happening. County media convergence centre, so it reports a new hotel enthusiastically and will not report a failed one.
sources.notes: Carries roughly 70 percent of any given week. Newsroom 0572-8661890, dqnews@163.com.

sources.robots: HanWeb CMS, listing pages scrapable, no feed
sources.cadence: several items per day across columns
sources.publishes: Ticket price adjustments, scenic area closures, resort planning, event launches, tenders
sources.authority: HIGHEST. Price changes and closures are legally required to be published here. Nothing overrides it.
sources.notes: Bureau namespace is /hzgov/front/sNNN/. s203 = culture, broadcasting, tourism and sports bureau. s232 = Moganshan Town. Watch col1229212604 in early February for the 新春第一会 ten openings document.

sources.nameZh: 湖州市文化广电旅游局
sources.nameEn: Huzhou Municipal Bureau of Culture, Radio, TV and Tourism
sources.publishes: Municipal tourism statistics, holiday visitor numbers, resort industry conferences, market inspections
sources.authority: HIGH for visitor statistics and holiday data. The only acceptable source for visitor numbers alongside the provincial department.

sources.nameZh: 浙江省文化广电和旅游厅
sources.nameEn: Zhejiang Provincial Department of Culture, Radio, TV and Tourism
sources.publishes: Province wide policy, A level scenic area rating changes, resort designations, subsidy programmes
sources.authority: HIGHEST for A level and resort status changes and province wide rules. Moganshan is a national level resort, so designation news lands here.

sources.nameZh: 莫干山国际旅游度假区
sources.publishes: Official ticketing and scenic area announcements, presumed
sources.notes: Returns 403 from outside China. Booking page, ticket tariff and any official WeChat mini programme could not be read. MANUAL CHECK REQUIRED from inside China before relying on it. Ticketing enquiries 0572-8412345 (verified against two independent sources).

sources.nameZh: 中国旅游报 / 中国旅游新闻网
sources.publisher: 中国旅游报社有限公司, a directly affiliated unit of the Ministry of Culture and Tourism
sources.publishes: National policy of record: visa rules, A level ratings, industry regulation
sources.authority: HIGHEST for national policy. Rarely covers Moganshan directly, use for the policy backdrop.

sources.nameZh: 中国天气网 莫干山镇
sources.publishes: Typhoon, heavy rain, snow and ice warnings
sources.authority: The leading indicator for mountain road closures. A Moganshan road closure is nearly always weather driven.
sources.notes: Station code 101210204004 is Moganshan Town. 101210204 is Deqing county seat. The mountain runs several degrees cooler, which is the whole marketing premise, so always use the town code.

sources.nameZh: 浙江在线 湖州频道

sources.publishes: Provincial features on Deqing, summer season launches, conference coverage
sources.authority: MEDIUM. Much Deqing content is contributed by 爱德清 and local propaganda departments and republished verbatim. Check the byline. Treat republished items at county trust level, not provincial.
sources.notes: No date in the URL. The sweep script cannot date these automatically, so they land in the manual triage bucket. Verified client rendered: the homepage returns 1.8MB with zero server side article links. Manual check only.

sources.publishes: Moganshan as a Hangzhou weekend destination
sources.notes: Hangzhou is Moganshan's number one origin market, so the angle is exactly the one an English travel site needs. The mid January race calendar release has run here. Returns HTTP 503 to a non browser user agent. requiresBrowserHeaders is set.

sources.publishes: National wire coverage of Deqing, conferences, rural revitalisation
sources.authority: HIGH, with the same county supplied copy caveat
sources.notes: AVOID zj.xinhuanet.com, it has a TLS certificate hostname mismatch and automated fetchers fail cert validation. Use www.news.cn paths only. The deqingzt topic page is stale, newest links seen are 2022. Treat as low priority and search www.news.cn for 莫干山 by hand instead.

sources.nameZh: 澎湃新闻 澎湃浙江
sources.publishes: Overtourism, homestay oversupply, occupancy collapse, sceptical reporting
sources.authority: HIGH. The most likely Chinese source to publish something negative or sceptical about Moganshan. Valuable counterweight to promotional sources.
sources.notes: www.thepaper.cn returns 403 to non browser clients. Use m.thepaper.cn with a browser user agent. Low frequency, worth a manual search rather than a listing crawl. m.thepaper.cn returned 403 even with browser headers in testing. Treat as a manual weekly search for 莫干山.

sources.nameZh: 南太湖号 / 湖州日报
sources.notes: Huzhou Media Group convergence app with no good open web mirror. Do not chase it. Use zjol-huzhou and huzhou-cts for Huzhou level news instead.

listings.label: 莫干山搜索
listings.note: Search results are client rendered. Server HTML is an 8KB shell with zero article links. Check by hand, or crawl sitemap_index.xml instead.

sources.publishes: Hotel openings, signings, brand launches, M and A, occupancy and RevPAR data
sources.authority: TRADE. Runs brand supplied press releases near verbatim. Announced opening dates slip constantly.
sources.notes: The cleanest scraping target in the registry. Sister properties: 迈点研究院 res.meadin.com, 迈点指数 i.meadin.com. NEVER publish an opening off this alone. Confirm trading on Dianping or Ctrip first.
Less useful for a single resort opening than Meadin, more useful for Ctrip, Meituan and Fliggy strategy that changes how Moganshan gets sold.

sources.publishes: Long form analysis of hotel asset deals, brand strategy, why a resort failed
sources.authority: OPINION, NOT RECORD. Never cite for a number.
sources.notes: Verified client rendered. Monitor via the syndication mirrors instead: jiemian.com, 36kr.com, tmtpost.com, news.qq.com.

CORRECTION TO ANY WATCH LIST: premium Moganshan inventory is naked Retreats, 郡安里, 开元森泊, 法国山居, 大乐之野, 西坡 and hundreds of independents. Aman, Banyan Tree and IHG have NO verified Moganshan property. A watch list built on those three returns nothing.

sources.nameEn: Deqing county media convergence WeChat accounts
sources.publishes: Holiday programmes 7 to 10 days before each Golden Week and Spring Festival, road restriction notices, event announcements
sources.authority: PROMOTIONAL. Event dates are usually right. Visitor numbers, superlatives and first in China claims are not.
sources.notes: WeChat official accounts are not addressable by URL. This is the operative publisher for road restrictions, usually via 德清县公安局交通警察大队, not the transport bureau.

sources.authority: NEVER CITE FOR AN OFFICIAL PRICE.
sources.notes: Worst offenders for stale prices. One page was still headlined 2025莫干山门票 while carrying text written 18 July 2022 quoting 68 RMB.

Deqing sits under the Huzhou city node. Filter by 新店, sort by 最新开业. BEST SINGLE CONFIRMATION that a venue is actually trading, which is step two of the hotel opening chain. Aggressive anti scraping, treat as manual.
Filter hotel search by 新开业 to confirm rooms are actually bookable. Also the affiliate partner, so treat commercial pages with care in editorial.
Sort by 最新 for new venues, 最热 for trends. Login walled and heavily bot protected. TREND SIGNAL ONLY, never a source for prices or dates.
Hashtag view counts week over week. A new POI or 团购 listing in 抖音生活服务 is a reliable opening signal. Hard blocked to bots, manual only.
热门游记 and 攻略. Slower moving, better for itinerary shifts than for news.
Price cross check only. Never the authoritative tariff.

standingWatch.why: Due around end 2026, biggest structural change to access
Sources disagree, tiering may change seasonally

standingWatch.item: Shuttle hours and last bus down
standingWatch.why: Varies seasonally, extended to 21:30 in summer 2025
Still listed by Lonely Planet and TripAdvisor, likely defunct

doNotPublish.finding: Absent from every 2025 and 2026 race calendar. Endurance events here are trail and triathlon.

doNotPublish.claim: Deqing or Moganshan bamboo culture festival
doNotPublish.finding: 中国竹文化节 belongs to Anji, the neighbouring county. Bamboo appears in Moganshan marketing but not as a named festival.
No evidence. Deqing is not a hot spring destination in the way Anji or Ninghai are.

doNotPublish.claim: Annual camping festival or branded annual music festival
doNotPublish.finding: Both appear only inside the summer season umbrella, no standalone brand verified.

doNotPublish.claim: 防风王庙会 on the 24th day of the eighth lunar month
doNotPublish.finding: Folklore, not a schedule. The 防风传说 legend itself is confirmed national intangible cultural heritage.

doNotPublish.claim: Any named official Moganshan ticketing WeChat account or mini programme
doNotPublish.finding: Not confirmed. Every result claiming to be the official entry point was a reseller, including 大河票务网. One almost certainly exists but do not name it without verifying from inside China.

Could not be confirmed from an authoritative source. Best supported structure is 80 RMB admission plus 15 RMB internal shuttle, with reported seasonal tiering of 100 peak, 80 shoulder, 50 low, and a separate 35 RMB up and down shuttle. Publish the range and the disagreement.
